about: Armour sets: the stats every piece of a set has alike, kept once, and the ids of the set's pieces in items/data/armor.json. A set's colours are the colour each channel of its armour's mask was painted for the Archive's icons, and why; the Items page does not show them.

colours.basis: The 9.1.5 client's Angel colours, near-white on all three masks; detail sheet and mask 0 and 5 assumed, as no picture of Angel or of its 2007 texture group decides them.
As the regular set (bear), by the owner's direction on 2026-10-19 that an (L) set looks as its regular set: Reproduced from extant imagery.

Chosen for the Archive by its owner, 2026-10-19, region by region on the harness: the chest (the red mask) #000276, the lower sides (green) #D2DC8A, the strap area (blue) #2F3048. The detail sheet and mask (1 and 7) are those itemicon.py armour-fit fits to the February 2004 Item Info harness (media/f8r4dx15), 0.724 against 0.564 for mask 5.
As the regular set (bodyguard), by the owner's direction on 2026-10-19 that an (L) set looks as its regular set: Reproduced from extant imagery.

Chosen for the Archive by its owner, 2026-10-19, region by region on the harness: the chest panels (the red mask) #FFFFFF, the lower sides and chest emblem (green) #2A2A43, the shoulders and strap band (blue) #CD1417. The detail sheet and mask (1 and 7) are Shogun's, at the owner's direction; no picture of Dragon decides them.
As the regular set (ghost), by the owner's direction on 2026-10-19 that an (L) set looks as its regular set: Reproduced from extant imagery.

FITTED, the owner's choice on 2026-10-19: yellow and green scaled to the median yellow and green pixels of the owner's undated video still of a Goblin set in the inventory, from a start at #E4DAB2 and #7B9B76 that the owner picked by eye. Colour 3 is the green again; which mask takes which colour is each piece's own channels.
ASSUMED: the 9.1.5 client's Hunter colours under its 2007 rule, a starting point not yet checked against a picture.

Fitted to two dated pictures of the set in the Archive, the May 2005 inventory (media/vf1j5mcs) and the February 2004 Item Info harness (media/qyakjm11), by itemicon.py armour-test: the light colour a copper, not 9.1.5's orange. Colour 3, white, the owner's choice on 2026-10-19 so the gloves' grey fingers stay silver under the 5.4 client's colour matrix: only the gloves take it, on their green mask, which has no marker and paints only the grey artwork; the other pieces' blue mask takes colour 2, as dark as before.

Chosen for the Archive by its owner, 2026-10-19, against a picture of three avatars in the suit the owner supplied and the June 2004 Item Info harness (media/wh14qj1h): both show the yellow pale, at hue 58 to 60 and saturation 0.34 to 0.35, where the 9.1.5 client's #AFA936 has 0.69. The yellow takes the red and blue masks and black the green; drawn on the family-A classes, as 5.4 has no Pixie, with the detail sheet and mask (1 and 7) itemicon.py fits to the June 2004 harness, the only mask with the tribal flames that harness and the worn suit show.

Adjusted for the Archive from its owner's estimate (#2B3287 and #FFFFFF), 2026-10-14, to a daylight picture of a woman and a man in the full suit by February 2007 (media/rhvvb7j3), balanced by the suit's own white plates: its blue measures hue 244, saturation 0.77 and value 0.44, which #2D2391 renders as 245, 0.76 and 0.44, where the estimate gave 235, 0.69 and 0.41. The detail sheet and mask (0 and 5) are what Settler's 2007 texture group fits, what every piece in that picture shows, and what itemicon.py armour-fit fits to the February 2004 Item Info harness (media/r2gnab8e), 0.88 against 0.66.
As the regular set (thunderbird), by the owner's direction on 2026-10-19 that an (L) set looks as its regular set: Reproduced from extant imagery.

The 9.1.5 client's Vigilante colours under its 2007 rule; the detail sheet and mask (0 and 5) fitted by itemicon.py to two dated Item Info pictures in the Archive, April 2005 (media/zd3ecn7z) and February 2004 (media/cphk44s5).

Chosen for the Archive by its owner, 2026-10-14, against the February 2004 Item Info harness (media/3m2s7jjp) with that window's blue cast taken out (measured by Settler's white in the same window): the yellow matches it in hue (62) and value, the blue in hue (210) and value, at a stronger saturation (0.76 against 0.60). The yellow is on the mask's blue channel, not where the 2007 rule puts it: itemicon.py armour-fit fits that and detail 0 over mask 5 to the harness, 0.67 and 0.78 on its two frames, where the 2007 rule's assignment reaches 0.36. Only the harness is pictured in 2004; the other pieces are drawn the same way.
As the regular set (zombie), by the owner's direction on 2026-10-19 that an (L) set looks as its regular set: Reproduced from extant imagery.
